name: Sagashiya Kisen ~Aenja no Toshi no Tazunebito~
original_name: 捜し屋キセン ～エニヤの都市のたずねびと～
source:
Kisen runs a tracing agency in Stanisla, a city far from his home, together with Beatrix, a talking pocket watch that his deceased brother left for him. There, he is asked by a local university student Dimir to look for his younger brother who disappeared twelve years ago.

Twelve years ago, there was three peculiar incidents in Stanisla: the serial kidnapping case, the acrid smell at the city's traditional Aenjan Festival, and the suicide by drowning of a foreign clockmaker, i.e. Kisen's brother.

As he learns more about what happened back then, he understands the struggle between the brothers and the true intention behind the series of incidents.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4229250/Kisen_Seeker_of_Aenjan_City/]Steam[/url]]
